close_reason:
Added crate-jmap-mail-types/src/capability.rs with 3 capability URI consts (JMAP_MAIL_URI, JMAP_SUBMISSION_URI, JMAP_VACATIONRESPONSE_URI) and 5 typed wire-format structs (MailCapability, MailAccountCapability, SubmissionCapability, SubmissionAccountCapability, VacationResponseCapability), all per RFC 8621 §1.3. Wired through lib.rs re-exports.

jmap-mail-client now uses the URI consts in its USING_MAIL/SUBMISSION/VACATION slice constants and the two session.primary_account_id() production-code call sites (mail_account_id, session_parts). Doc-comment URI text strings left as-is.

Capability structs do NOT carry extras-preservation 'extra' field — matches the in-tree SieveCapability precedent and the 6 sibling extension-types capability structs (calendars, tasks, contacts, filenode, sharing, metadata are all bare-fields). Whether to add 'extra' to capability structs is a separate workspace-architectural decision; the bead's note suggesting #[serde(flatten)] extra: Map was set aside in favour of cross-crate consistency.

Sibling extension-client URI-const adoption tracked as follow-up bd:JMAP-ops7.16.

Workspace cargo test, clippy, and rustdoc all clean. 6 new capability tests pass (round-trip MailAccountCapability+SubmissionAccountCapability, empty-{} session-level for the 3 capability structs, URI const verbatim match to RFC 8621 IANA registrations).
description:
**Files**:
- crate-jmap-mail-types/src/ — NO \`MailCapability\`, NO \`MailAccountCapability\`, NO \`JMAP_MAIL_URI\`
- crate-jmap-mail-client/src/lib.rs:53, 62, 69 — hardcodes \`"urn:ietf:params:jmap:mail"\` in doc comments and method body
- crate-jmap-mail-client/src/methods/email.rs:36, 128, 171, 247, 315, 405, 479 — hardcodes the URI string 7+ more times

**Divergence**: 6 of 8 extension type crates expose a capability struct + URI const in *-types (calendars, tasks, contacts, filenode, sharing, metadata). mail-types and chat-types are the two exceptions. RFC 8621 §2 defines a non-trivial mail capability object with fields:
- \`maxMailboxesPerEmail: u64 | null\`
- \`maxMailboxDepth: u64 | null\`
- \`maxSizeMailboxName: u64\`
- \`maxSizeAttachmentsPerEmail: u64\`
- \`emailQuerySortOptions: Vec<String>\`
- \`mayCreateTopLevelMailbox: bool\`

None of these are surfaced as a Rust struct in the workspace.

**What goes wrong**:
1. The most-mature crate in the workspace has no canonical capability surface. New extensions have to invent the URI-const pattern fresh because mail-types doesn't model it.
2. mail-client hardcodes the URI string \`"urn:ietf:params:jmap:mail"\` in 10+ places. A typo in any one of them is a runtime 'no primary account' error visible only at integration-test time.
3. Server-side consumers building session-responses have no way to import \`MailAccountCapability\` to construct the per-account cap-advertising object. They have to roll their own serde struct or use \`serde_json::json!({...})\` literals.
4. mail-server's per-method cap methods (\`max_body_value_bytes\`, \`max_delayed_send_seconds\`, \`max_sieve_script_bytes\`, \`max_collapse_threads_emails\`) return raw \`u64\` values but there's no single struct that collects them for advertisement. (Per AGENTS.md the workspace's preferred pattern is now \`limits() -> XxxLimits\` struct — chat-server and calendars-server use this shape. mail-server's per-method pattern is documented as predating the convention, but the capability surface is the natural home for the same data.)

**Fix**: add \`crate-jmap-mail-types/src/capability.rs\` with:
\`\`\`rust
pub const JMAP_MAIL_URI: &str = "urn:ietf:params:jmap:mail";

#[non_exhaustive]
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")]
pub struct MailCapability {} // session-level empty marker per RFC 8621 §2

#[non_exhaustive]
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")]
pub struct MailAccountCapability {
    pub max_mailboxes_per_email: Option<u64>,
    pub max_mailbox_depth: Option<u64>,
    pub max_size_mailbox_name: u64,
    pub max_size_attachments_per_email: u64,
    pub email_query_sort_options: Vec<String>,
    pub may_create_top_level_mailbox: bool,
    #[serde(flatten, default, skip_serializing_if = "serde_json::Map::is_empty")]
    pub extra: serde_json::Map<String, serde_json::Value>,
}
\`\`\`
Then mail-client replaces all 10+ hardcoded strings with the imported const.

Sibling reference: crate-jmap-calendars-types/src/capability.rs.
title: mail-types lacks `MailCapability` / `MailAccountCapability` struct and `JMAP_MAIL_URI` const; mail-client hardcodes the URI string in 10+ places
